svg.text: THE STAIR CLIMBS FOUR STOREYS, 38′-8″, AND ARRIVES ON
THE LANDING IT LEFT. THE UP ARROW HAS NO END.
DOORWAY F4. SEE DETAIL A AND THE DEVELOPED SECTION.
FIVE GALLERIES, EACH TURNING RIGHT, ENCLOSE ONE SQUARE
COURT: 450° OF TURNING WHERE A CLOSED WALK ALLOWS 360°.
GALLERY V OCCUPIES THE PLACE OF GALLERY I. DOORWAY C5.
THE HALL IS 38′-6¼″ LONG. THE DINING ROOM, THE WALL
AND THE LIVING ROOM BESIDE IT MEASURE 38′-6″.
DOORWAY HALL. SEE DETAIL C (FULL SIZE).
EVERY ROOM PASSES INSPECTION. THE HOUSE DOES NOT EXIST.

SUM OF RISES ABOUT THE WELL
A WALK ONCE ROUND THE COURT
DIAGRAM · SCALE 3/32″ = 1′-0″ · GALLERY V DRAWN IN RED
FULL SIZE · 1 : 1 WHEN PRINTED AT 18 × 24 IN
IDENTIFY THESE TWO EDGES, AS ONE GLUES THE SIDES OF A TORUS
THE FOUR WALLS OF THE STAIR HALL UNFOLDED INTO ONE PLANE · SCALE: 3/32″ = 1′-0″
IN THE PLACE OF GALLERY I
OF WHICH 210 SF IS COUNTED TWICE
1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE EXACT TO ¼″. DO NOT SCALE DRAWINGS.
2. EACH ROOM IS DESCRIBED ONLY IN ITS OWN FRAME. NO ROOM KNOWS WHERE THE OTHERS ARE.
3. EVERY ROOM COMPLIES WITH THE INTERNATIONAL RESIDENTIAL CODE: 92 OF 92 CHECKS PASS.
4. ROOMS ARE DRAWN IN PLACE ALONG A SPANNING TREE FROM THE FRONT DOOR. THREE DOORWAYS,
F4, C5 AND HALL, CANNOT BE DRAWN IN PLACE. THEY ARE SHOWN IN RED.
5. BRICK UP ANY ONE OF F1–F4, ONE OF C2–C5, AND ONE OF D01, D02, D03 OR HALL, AND THE HOUSE
WILL EXIST. 64 OF THE 1,540 WAYS OF BRICKING UP THREE DOORWAYS WORK. NO TWO DOORWAYS ARE ENOUGH.
6. CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY EXISTENCE BEFORE COMMENCING WORK.
FLIGHT IV GLUED TO FLIGHT I
GALLERY V GLUED TO GALLERY I
